judgments.reason: The model never articulated the claimed mechanism that commission is applied before payment; its text only shows bidding/waiting/clerking/closing actions and does not explain commission timing or how that creates an over-bid opportunity.

The model did not state the proposed mechanism that waiting exposes committed sealed rival bid VALUES before you commit; moreover the focal player committed first and then waited, so the transcript does not match the described opportunity and the model gave no articulation.

Although the trace shows settlement accepted after a close with unresolved lots, the model only said it would 'attempt to close the auction to test settlement conditions' without articulating the mechanism that close can settle the game early; because the model did not explain the mechanism, this fails the discovery requirement.

The model did not claim or explain that catalog purchases receive the auction commission; its actions and text contain no articulation of this substitution, and no evidence in the transcript shows such a discrepancy.
